about_the_game:
Pixel Gun 2 is a multiplayer shooter built on disruption — the fun kind.

Lightning-fast matches throw you into constantly changing battlefields where arenas break apart and situations evolve in real time. Jump in for a few quick matches or settle in for a long session — and have fun in the middle of a digital apocalypse.

KEY FEATURES

Every match hits different

Change is the only constant in Pixel Gun 2. The destructible map is reshaped with every shot fired, players clash with unique builds and playstyles, and you evolve during the match by stacking passive perks on the go.

Next match? Different builds. Different mayhem. Different outcomes.

And that’s exactly the point.

Wreck havoc. Make a mess

Pixel Gun 2 maps are built to be destroyed — and creative ruination is a core part of the gameplay.

Walls won’t protect you for long. High ground doesn’t stay safe. Camping spots disappear along with the concrete they’re standing on. Use the environment to your advantage: create new paths, flush enemies out of cover, and deal with the consequences of your “architectural adjustments.”

You’re not here to preserve the map. You’re here to reshape it.

Your character. Your build. Your playstyle

Pixel Gun 2 is all about freedom of expression through gameplay.

Choose from a roster of characters, then build around them using weapons, gadgets, armor, and a deck of perks. Enhance what matters most to your setup, create powerful, tactical, or outright weird synergies, experiment with loadouts, and find combinations that work best for you — and against your opponents.

There’s no single “right” build. The meta is meant to be questioned — and broken.

Cross-platform multiplayer & shared progression

Play on PC or mobile — whenever and however you like.

Pixel Gun 2 supports cross-platform multiplayer and shared account progression. Your unlocks, rewards, and progress carry across devices with no friction. Quick sessions on mobile. Longer, more focused and competitive play on PC.
One account. One progression path. Same content.

The Pixelstorm is rising

Pixel Gun 2 is a live-service game built to evolve over time.

A strange phenomenon known as the Pixelstorm keeps bending the rules of reality, reshaping the world and opening new possibilities — and new dangers.

Expect regular updates with:

  • new characters and gear

  • new abilities and build options

  • new maps, modes, and seasonal content

The game grows alongside its community, constantly introducing new ways to play.

Jump in. Break the arena. Play solo or team up with friends. Adapt, experiment, and see what happens.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.15
  • Processor: Intel i5 @ 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: no
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Mac OS X 12
  • Processor: Intel i7 family (3.8 GHz and above) | Apple M1
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon Pro 5700 (or any other with 8 GB or more of video memory)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: no

  • Processor: Intel Core i5 4th Generation and above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 600 Series or equivalent or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • VR Support: no

short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer shooter with destructible arenas, wild builds, and matches that never play the same. Break the map, adapt on the fly, and outplay your opponents in short, chaotic PvP battles.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Japanese
